proves.claim: A green gate receipt posted through boardJobQueueCall for a submitted sprint item with a green screen on the trunk tip calls the landing starter once, as for a verified item, and a screen that applies green after the receipt calls it once too.

api.gate.sprint-land.start-on-green-scre.why: Without it a screened sprint item would never reach the lander and would wait for an accept like steady.

proves.claim: A landed land receipt posted through boardJobQueueCall marks a submitted sprint item with a green screen on the job's trunk merged, where it was skipped as not verified.

api.gate.sprint-land.receipt-marks-merge.why: Without it a sprint item the runner landed would stay unrecorded on the board.

proves.claim: A submitted steady item gets no landing start and is not marked merged, and its receipts read no screen; a sprint item with a red screen or a green screen on an older tip gets neither.

api.gate.sprint-land.steady-and-stale-un.why: Sprint wiring must change nothing for steady items and must never land on a red or stale screen.
